The app controller invokes the context tool directly; app rejects missing context result and bounds repeated context reads. Existing GRDB MemoryStore retains working task state rather than adding Python checkpoint storage. Full graph runtime not bundled.

Local adapters: CompanionDecision guided-generation schema distinguishes new goals, cancellation reports, user-reported step completion, proposed next step and final answer. App validates message identity, literal quote support, spatial claims and stale request/goal revision. Working state stores goal/revision, proposed step, reported-completed steps and bounded source reports in existing protected on-phone companion namespace. A child report is NOT sensor-confirmed action or arrival. Child reports are provided separately from prior assistant output; generated replies never become observation facts. Reports trimmed for model context do not erase stored state.

Evidence: copied/pinned upstream source and hashes in ios/.reference-materials/agent-control-review; upstream source/tests not executed. Xcode builds and actual app UI results are recorded separately. No claim that all upstream strengths are ported or all model/robotics weaknesses removed. No new dependency installation, weights, Docker, cloud calls, or project regeneration.

Runtime correction after live failure: model-selected context read plus full structured decision exceeded60s. Context is now invoked directly as a mandatory controller prerequisite, then its completed result is supplied to a native streaming session. The model does NOT choose a context tool call on this path. Typed state-update classification and source-quoted fact fields precede the answer in the guided schema. The app compares extracted subject/value with its saved previous report; complete replies pass spatial checks before display. A displayed fact is persisted immediately so interruption of remaining task metadata does not lose that acknowledged report. Extraction remains model-dependent: literal quote checks do not prove semantic correctness or sensor truth. Task fields remain tentative until full generation and stale-state checks pass.30s deadline prevents a stuck Thinking state; it is a failure bound, not an instant-response guarantee. New goals/cancellation discard stale proposed work; fresh observations/physical tool integration remain separate.

Superseding correction 2026-10-22: actual UI showed malformed subject/value rendering and slow replies. Removed code-rendered model-extracted fact replies and their early-commit callback. Answer is now the first generated field; metadata follows. Context supplies original child reports in chronological order, prior assistant reply explicitly not evidence, and original saved quotes rather than extracted values. Current request is no longer duplicated in recent reports. Source reports persist before inference, even if later metadata is interrupted. Full generation still required before task updates commit. This reduces avoidable work before the answer; latency/quality require actual UI verification.

Further feedback correction: original quoted child reports remain; prior assistant reply removed entirely from model input after live retest still invented object absence. Task request extraction copies the full explicit child request to avoid paraphrase validation loss. Cancellation returns before accepting a generated next step. Missing-location workflow asks for last-reported location without asserting search results. These are local adapters, not new upstream code ports. Latest UI result is recorded separately.

Latest runtime separation: debug-only --chat-baseline isolates a minimal plain reply without task metadata (one UI request passed). Normal path now streams a plain natural reply before a separate guided state-extraction call in the same session. State extraction cannot rewrite the reply. Empty map record arrays are omitted, actual historical map/preferences retained with source labeling. Timeout preserves an already displayed reply; uncommitted metadata is discarded. Prior schema-first discussion above is historical. Latest full-path results remain in text-chat-status.json.

Compact context follow-up: role reduced to purpose, available evidence, useful clarification, task agency and concise output. Empty fields, older extracted fact quotes and exact duplicate earlier copies of current input omitted from model context. Full protected persisted records are retained, but current prompt is bounded; general long-term retrieval remains unfinished.
